chapter: Idaho tours, Music Town and retirement
title: Reading the poster for Reb Spikes and His Majors and Minors Orchestra
summary: Willard reads the two-color poster naming Hollywood McCoy, the Vitaphone film band and the Carioca dancers; the Oriental tour never happened.

bands.name: Reb Spikes and His Majors and Minors Orchestra

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: I see. It's very impressive. This poster is about two by three feet or more, and printed in two colors, and it says, "Look, They're Coming! Ten Colored Entertainers--Ten! Reb Spikes, Writer of 'Someday Sweetheart,' 'My Mammy's Blues,' 'Fight

That Thing,' 'Crooked Blues--They Ain't Straight,' 'You'll Never Have No Luck By Quittin' Me,' 'Can't Help It Blues,' 'Love, Love, Why Do You Seem So Hard to Hold?' 'Maybe, Someday,' 'The Whole World Seems Wrong' and many others." And it says, "Ten Recording Artists--Ten. Big Floor Shows Through The Entire Evening. Entertainment You'll Enjoy From Start To Finish. Come Early, Stay Late. A Show You'll Always Remember. A Band You Will Never Forget. You Can't Afford To Miss It," and in big green letters, "REB SPIKES AND HIS BAND," and then on the cut, which is from the pictures, you said, right? -- "Reb Spikes and his Majors and Minors Orchestra, Columbia Recording Orchestra," and it's a very impressive picture. It looks like about twenty-five instruments amongst about...
That's the band that made the first picture for Warner Bros.
That's the Vitaphone Band. Is that right?
Yes.
And then it says, "Kings of Syncopation and Modern Dance Rhythm -- Just Returned From Oriental Tour." Oh, you didn't tell me about the Orient.
We never did go. We had the contract but they wouldn't go.

And see Hollywood's Most Popular Dancing Stars and Entertainers. A Guaranteed Attraction. One of the Greatest Colored Orchestras in the Country Today. Ten Talented and Exceptionally Clever Musicians and Entertainers in Action -- Keeping You on Your Toes Every Minute. You will Dance Like You Never Danced Before to

SPIKES - 41
Reel 2
Page 7
the Red Hot Unrestrained Jazzy Music As Only This Colored Orchestra Can Play -- Featuring Hollywood McCoy"(that's Austin McCoy, is that right?)
Yeah.
"The Sensational Pianist of Modern Harmony -- A Real Treat and a Whole Show By Himself..."
Yes.
"Don't Miss This Attraction." What was... how was he a whole show in himself? Was he...?

Well, he'd do all of that of that kind of stuff and turn and play backwards, and he'd kick up and dance and, you know, he was a regular monkey on the piano. Yeah, and people used to... everybody stopped dancing to watch him, you know.

Oh, I see. And then it says, "Smiles and..." What is it? Smiles and... Smiley... I can't read it. The poster is a little...uh...worn right there. What is it? "Smiles and somebody... Smiles and Smile..."
That's a dance team.
Yeah, and here about a camera..."Doing The Famous 'Carioca' at the Club..."
Yeah. "Flying Down To Rio."
Uh huh. And "Don't Miss This Big Frolic at Shadowland. Dancing 75 cents a couple. Extra Ladies, 25 cents." I love that.
That was big money.

SPIKES - 42
Reel 2
Page 8
That...That's very interesting. How about... were there ever any "Extra Gentlemen"?
I don't know. Not aware of that.
But they didn't have a special price for them.
